positionUnitsPerMetre.source: measured on this lap: raw position path length divided by the lap length obtained by integrating published speed over the sample timestamps

elevation.reason: the elevation channel varies by only 2.8m over the lap, below the 3m floor this project treats as a real profile

limitations: Each line is one driver's fastest non-out lap of qualifying, not an average and not an ideal line.
Position samples arrive at roughly 3.7 Hz and are resampled onto a fixed distance grid, so the line is interpolated between samples.
Corner numbering is not published by this source, so the map carries the driven path and no official corner labels.
